(2) Add `MaxResponseBytes: yc.intDefault(yc.MaxResponseBytes, DefaultMaxResponseBytes),` to `toConfig()`. (3) Add `NEXUS_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES` env-override branch in `LoadYAML()` following the `NEXUS_MAX_BODY_BYTES` pattern.
